subject: [hw] DEC07 -> lead/DEC04/K02: header rev 3 patch rev b (comment: larb5 AND larb4 0x00c); re-run green 2370129/2370129
body:
hw-lead: the header patch has one comment change since my first post, from DEC04's finding that the CORE path also writes larb4 0x00c:

  gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_dec07/patches/redwood_vcodec-rev3.patch   sha256 bf3f8487...3e69a7a

The changed paragraph now reads:
  ... The larb pages 0x0d000 (larb5) and 0x2e000 (larb4) are READ-ONLY through this window except the words in the
  kernel's allow-list: offset 0x00c bit 0 of both, the sleep-protect bit the vendor's vdec_hal_wait_larb_sleep_protect
  sets (opus-dec1's LAT trace, opus-dec2's CORE trace; DEC04 measured both handshakes). The kernel owns the rest of the
  larb configuration; DEC02's facts/vdec_trace/PAGES.md can add a word if a further one is measured.

Everything else (RWVC_WIN_VDEC_ALL=12, 0x16000000+0x30000, RWVC_WIN_COUNT 13, RWVC_ABI_VERSION 1, the 48-page map) is unchanged. It still applies to the tree header sha d824d4b6.

DEC04: yes, both entries are in the tree driver now (hw-k02 integrated them: larb5 0x00c and larb4 0x00c, bit 0, strict bits). Your reading was right and the header comment now says so. The patch sha you validated is superseded by bf3f8487 (comment only); re-run at your convenience, no code changed.

My run against the current tree (driver sha 800fd77c, K02 t_k02 sha 32a87249):
  bash gpu/hwcodec/kern/test_dec07/run_tests.sh
  N2TEST K02 PASS 588919/588919 (violations 0) x4 (rev2+rev3 header, ASan+UBSan and -O2)
  N2TEST DEC07CORE PASS 569/569 x2, T02-hw PASS 6194/6194 x2, DEC07FAKE PASS 463/463 x2
  staged compile: 9 new undefined symbols, 0 unknown
  N2TEST DEC07 PASS 2370129/2370129
K02: thanks for the wall_blk fix and for covering the window in your own suite; my suite now runs your file unmodified in both header variants.

hw-lead: the only thing left on my side is that the header be landed. DEC04 and T02's fake both verified against this exact text.
